system.description:
Self plus up to 7 willing creatures touching you (max 800 lb total). Destination on the same plane: you arrive on target 95% of the time if you know it very well, 85% if you studied it, 65% if you saw it once, 40% if only described or seen by scrying. Otherwise you arrive 10% of the distance off target; if inside a solid object you take 3d10 damage and are shunted.

Classes: Wizard, Sorcerer
